I fixed the source in two places and left the tests alone. The full suite now passes: 517 of 517.

1. **`958d3ae` (thousands separators):** `formatMoney` padded cents on the wrong side (`padEnd` instead of `padStart`), so 1¢ showed as `$0.10`. That caused the 4 money test failures and the wrong PIN-03 row in the render tests. Fix is in `src/money.js`.
2. **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork):** the invoice was taxed on the subtotal before the order-level discount code came off, so the CA-ON SPRING10 tax and total were wrong. I changed `taxable` back to `subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`. That fixed the 2 invoice tests and the render total row.

Everything else those commits added still works: the thousands separators, line discounts, the `lineDiscounts`/`taxable` fields on the invoice, the empty-invoice check and the extra render row. Nothing is committed yet.
